responsibility: Implements NEC V850 common option processing for CPU-family selection, small-data area sizing, and optimization defaults. It validates and records memory-area size options for TDA/SDA/ZDA against architecture limits, maps machine switches onto the internal V850/V850E/V850E2 family flag combinations, enables space/prolog-function behavior for -mspace, installs the V850-specific optimization default of using prolog functions when optimizing, and provides the default target flag baseline for later backend code generation.
